name: B10-0072/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Jean-Jacques Wondo, a Belgian and Congolese citizen held in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to get a fair trial and medical care. He was sentenced to death by a military court in September 2024 over an alleged coup plot. The Parliament opposes the death penalty, says civilians should not be tried by military courts, and asks Belgian and European Union officials to push for justice reforms in the country. This is an opinion, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking the Congo to stop executions and fix its courts.
- **Who it affects:** Wondo, 36 others sentenced with him, and Congo's justice system.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union officials and Congo's government and parliament.
